sources.finding: QTableView::columnResized starts a zero-duration column resize timer; geometry completes on the next event-loop turn. Use one single-shot QTimer for row reflow, coalescing column resize notifications.

sources.used: ResizeToContents for short columns; Stretch for effect text.

decision: Use mature Qt page/table behavior with the established shared public index, instead of adding another browser, fetching service or statistics implementation.
external_foundation: Existing Qt/qframelesswindow/PyQtDarkTheme runtime; no new dependency.
